svg.title: Let callers choose how long to wait
svg.desc: Milestone 2 overview in six perspective columns: Domain, Architecture, Subsystem Design, Subsystem Interfaces, State Management and Verification. Green outlines mark new subjects, blue outlines mark changed subjects and gray outlines mark unchanged context. RetryPolicy gains initial_delay and max_delay; the attempt loop asks a new wait schedule for the next wait and calls an injectable sleep function before each retry, never before the first call or after the last. Checks expect waits of 0.1, 0.2 and 0.25 seconds before reads two to four, no wait after a fourth failure, and no sleep at all when the delay is unset.
svg.text: Let callers choose how long to wait
Baseline: milestone 1 • Wait before each retry: initial_delay, doubling, capped at max_delay. Unset means no waits.
